title: Stage outputs envelope
description: A published outputs.json (005 FR-005, ADR-0004). `values` is checked against `<stage>.schema.json`. Rules beyond this schema, enforced by tools/internal/stacks: no object key anywhere in `values` matching `(?i)secret|password|token|private_key|access_key`; no null or empty string anywhere in `values`; no entry that `tofu output -json` marked sensitive; object keys match exactly (no case variants) and appear once.
